datasets.title: Yemen Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Yemen Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/yemen_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Yemen to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files for 2021, capturing spatial variation in food insecurity outcomes across administrative areas.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought and conflict-related disruptions.
